metadata.title: Building Payment Apps with Claude.ai and MoneyGraph
metadata.description: How to use Claude.ai Projects with MoneyGraph SDK. Copy our project instructions and let Claude build compliant payment integrations automatically.
metadata.author: MoneyGraph Team

seo.og_description: Use Claude.ai Projects to build payment apps with MoneyGraph. Our project instructions teach Claude compliance, FX patterns, and error handling.

content.intro: Claude.ai from Anthropic is one of the most capable AI assistants for complex reasoning and code generation. With MoneyGraph's CLAUDE_AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md, Claude understands how to build compliant payment applications from your first prompt.

claude_strengths: Understanding complex business logic (KYC flows, compliance rules)
Generating complete, working code (not just snippets)
moneygraph_provides: Multi-rail support (local, SWIFT, mobile money, crypto)

setup.heading: Setup: Add Project Instructions
steps: Create a new Project in Claude.ai
setup.note: That's it. Claude now understands MoneyGraph.

kyc_rule.name: The Golden Rule: KYC Before Payouts

quote_flow.name: Quote → Confirm → Payout

example_prompts.name: Build a Remittance API
example_prompts.prompt: Build a REST API for a remittance service using MoneyGraph. Users should be able to register, complete KYC, and send money to Nigeria.
claude_generates: Error handling with MoneyGraph error types

example_prompts.name: Create a Wallet System
example_prompts.prompt: Create a multi-currency wallet system where users can hold USD, EUR, and NGN. Include FX conversion between currencies.

example_prompts.name: Issue Virtual Cards
example_prompts.prompt: Build a virtual card issuance feature. Users with approved KYC can create USD cards and fund them from their wallet.

compliance_awareness.heading: Claude's Compliance Awareness
points: Never skips KYC - Always checks before payouts
Handles errors properly - Uses MoneyGraphError types
Uses environment variables - Never hardcodes secrets
Follows date formats - DD-MM-YYYY for birthdays

best_practices.example: Build a payout service that only allows payouts to verified customers, limits transactions to $10,000 per day, and sends email notifications on completion.
Build a KYC flow and explain why each step is necessary for regulatory compliance.
Include comprehensive error handling for all MoneyGraph error codes: KYC_PENDING, QUOTE_EXPIRED, etc.
